title: Underwriting Rule Card: One Open Employer Group Contract per Employer
content:
**Rule.** An employer holds at most one applied or active Cascade group contract; a second contract is not issued while one is applied or active. The rule governs the issue of Employer Group Contracts in every Cascade Group Dental & Vision segment.

| Item | Limit |
|---|---|
| Applied or active Employer Group Contracts held by one employer | 1 |

## Basis of the count

- The count is taken from the company's own records of the Employer Group Contracts held by the employer and the status of each, as they stand before a new contract is issued; what the employer states about its contracts is not the basis.
- Contracts are matched to the employer that holds them, and only that employer's contracts are counted.
- Only contracts whose status is applied or active count toward the limit.
- A new application is a contract record of its own, never an amendment of an existing contract.

## Status table

| Status of a contract the employer already holds | Bearing on issuing another contract |
|---|---|
| Applied (accepted for underwriting, not yet in effect) | another contract is not issued while it is applied |
| Active | another contract is not issued while it is active |
| Terminated | not counted toward the limit |
| Cancelled (application withdrawn before its effective date) | not counted toward the limit |

## Hypothetical cases

- An employer whose only Employer Group Contract was terminated applies again: the terminated contract is not counted, and this rule does not stand in the way of the new contract.
- An employer with an application still under underwriting submits a second application offering different plans: the second contract is not issued while the first is applied, whatever plans the second offers.
- Two employers each hold one active contract: each employer's contracts are counted on their own, and neither holding counts against the other employer.
